route.lua: local S = nova.scene_now(); S.state = 'lab'; S.def = { waves = {}, scrap = 0 }; for _, w in ipairs(nova.all('warn')) do w:destroy() end

local sg = nova.all('sign')[1]; SIGN = sg; local r = nova.named('runner'); r.x, r.y = sg.x - 160, sg.y + 60; local best, bd = nil, 1e9; for _, p in ipairs(nova.all('puddle')) do local d = math.abs(p.x - sg.x) + math.abs(p.y - sg.y); if d < bd then best, bd = p, d end end; PUD = best
local r = nova.named('runner'); r.x, r.y = PUD.x - 20, PUD.y
